---
title: ADA HPC
---

> Typical tasks: Data Transformation, Data Analysis.

[ADA](/tools/ada/index.qmd) is the compute cluster hosted on campus by IT for Research. 

::: {.description}

All VU researchers can get an [account](/tools/ada/cost_access.qmd). The cluster has fast access to your data on SciStor. Access is mainly through the command-line, so some CLI skills are needed. A limited amount of GUI tools is available via [Open OnDemand](/tools/ada/open-ondemand.qmd).

There are only limited resources available, although you can [buy hardware](/tools/ada/dedicated-nodes.qmd) for your research group.

:::
